about: Irregular verbs for Lingleaf: the single source for base forms (TextTools), past participles and base forms in FunctionWords/Verbs, and the irregular-verb reference. Identical in lingleaf-ios and lingleaf-android (SPEC.md, Shared logic). past/participle: most common form first (US spelling first when the UK one differs). freq: lemma frequency per million (wordfreq), for ordering only. level: approximate CEFR band of the verb's common meaning. es: the most common meanings, in Spanish. spokenAs: text the voice reads instead of a form that it would say wrong, by slot. homonym: a regular verb with the same base and another meaning (lie/lied, hang/hanged). nounFirst: the base is more often a noun; not taken as a verb after 'had better'. homographs: forms that are also another word; context decides (SPEC.md, verb-or-noun rule). ipa: optional, by slot, the pronunciation (IPA, no slashes) of the slot's first form, for forms whose sound depends on the reading (read past 'rɛd'; wind 'waɪnd', not the noun 'wɪnd'). llBases: bases in -ll whose US spelling keeps both l's before -ed/-ing (installed → install, not instal); tried before the single-l stem. homonym.homonymBefore / homonym.verbBefore: for the -s and -ing forms the homonym shares (lying, lies, hanging, hangs), the next word that makes them the homonym ('lying to') or the verb ('lying on'); else unsure. query/gloss (verb and homonym): an unambiguous English phrase to translate for that sense outside Spanish ('to lie down' / 'to tell a lie'), and a short English gloss shown when the two translated rows come out the same. homonym.noun/nounEs: the noun the twin's shared -s form can be ('lies' → 'lie', 'mentira'); sEs: the verb's meaning on a row against that noun. homographs nounIpa: the noun's pronunciation from its sentence, first rule that matches (near: a word of the sentence; after/before: the word right before/after; no condition: the default); expressions: the form + the next word as a unit ('bound for', 'bound to' + a base verb) with its own meanings.
